scope: stored JSON metadata only; no native fields/potentials/NPZ read, no new physical maps or scientific calculations

source_hash_verification.scope: report JSON, configuration, case summary and unloaded probe JSON only

GUI.kind: static offline tables, no external scripts/network

volume_scope.supplemental_ROI: whole native modeled XY cross-section, depth15..20mm; separately reported
volume_scope.coordinates: x,y horizontal; z positive depth from top, all positions mm
volume_scope.weights: saved fractional primary ROI and h^2 dz native full-cell volume; exact face-clipped slab
volume_scope.whole_XY_geometry: center-in-disk FVM square cells; staircase wall, not exact cylinder clipping; no volume renormalization
volume_scope.quantiles: stable inverse volume-weighted ECDF, searchsorted side=left; native cell steps/ties retained; no interpolation

metrics.maxTIS: fundamentals only, maximum over2074 sampled directions; lower bound to continuous direction maximum
metrics.RMS: total vector electric-field RMS including all4 stored square_3h spectral lines; not modulation

volume_scope.omitted: X/Y/Z directional scalar fields not cached; sine/triangle RMS not available in this archive
volume_scope.current_sum: sum of each physical output RMS including all harmonics/passive-frequency currents; bookkeeping, not common-GND return current
volume_scope.skin_contact_only: eight skin/contact burden caps, no source-power cap and no1Vpp ceiling; may exceed1Vpp numerically
volume_scope.legacy_composite_full_skin: same eight caps plus source-power cap and1Vpp ceiling
volume_scope.equal_current_and_power: no1Vpp ceiling; only named denominator is equalized
volume_scope.limits: frozen raw same-grid baseline numerical burdens and scalar cutoffs; not human safety/activation limits

circuit.note: C1 basis also separately evaluated at 3030 Hz; square_3h has explicit harmonics

probe.scope: raw unloaded probe predictions only; no newly reconstructed or loaded Vpp

coordinate_system.x_y_axes: local phantom coordinates; no anatomical anterior/posterior assignment
coordinate_system.displayed_depth: positive distance from skin surface, not from SC bottom

probe.loaded_prediction: held: phantom port impedance, actual switch/calibration/loading not verified
